segments.name: Consumer & Specialties
segments.description: Serves consumer end markets with mineral-to-market household products and specialty mineral-based additives for consumer and industrial goods.
segments.evidence: The Consumer & Specialties segment serves consumer end markets directly with mineral-to-market finished products and also provides specialty mineral-based solutions and technologies that are an essential component of our customers' finished products.

segments.name: Engineered Solutions
segments.description: Serves industrial end markets with engineered systems, mineral blends, and technologies that improve customers' manufacturing processes and projects.
segments.evidence: The Engineered Solutions segment serves industrial end markets with engineered systems, mineral blends, and technologies that are designed to improve our customers' manufacturing processes and projects .

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for specialty mineral products and engineered solutions, often under long-term evergreen satellite plant agreements supplying substantially all of a customer's requirements.
revenueModel.evidence: Generally, the Company and its customers enter into long-term evergreen agreements, initially ten to fifteen years in length, pursuant to which the Company supplies substantially all of the customers' requirements.
